name: Community Route - AI On Day One

communities.blurb: For alumni working in and around artificial intelligence.
communities.body:
A cross-chapter community for Harvard alumni working in AI — researchers, founders, product leaders, and the people deploying it inside larger companies.

This community is just getting started. Events, leads, and reading groups will appear here as they are scheduled.
communities.name: AI
communities.tagline: We are the AI Community of Harvard Alumni in Tech.

description: The state every community actually launches in: announced, with no leads named and nothing on the calendar. It now renders through CommunityPage rather than the chapter shell, so the hero kicker reads Community instead of naming the organisation — the old title produced HARVARD ALUMNI IN TECH AI, which read as a product rather than a group of people. The page still reads as finished, carried by the hero, the blurb and the join band. With nothing on the calendar the events section shows a heading and an empty-state box worded for a community, 'No AI events scheduled yet.', rather than the chapter phrasing 'No events scheduled in AI yet.', which read as if AI were a place. The big headings (hero, join band, events) spell the name out as Artificial Intelligence (AI) from the entry's full name; the empty line, the tab title and the nav keep the short form.
